summary: Round 4 (r4b2): no box from 12:50 to 23:19 UTC (no offer under the caps). Then, on an RTX 4080 (needed a gpu_health 4080 reference, harness issue), MEASURED the defect found offline: on the incumbent, the camera-only pitch head (sigma at the LOG_STD_MIN clamp, 0.0067) carries ~95% of PPO's per-update KL (pitch 0.16-1.39 vs yaw 0.005-0.05, keys 0.002) and 3/4 of the clipped rows (34% joint vs 9% without pitch). NEW --pitch-sigma-min 0.05 (off = bit-identical) cuts the joint KL to 0.03-0.09 and lets the keys/yaw use the trust region (their clipped share 9% -> 16%). Best eval 54.521 (bare resume's first eval; incumbent 54.674). Next: a matched-step test of the floor from the incumbent.
